$comment: Hand-curated input for scripts/scrape/items-client.mjs: Classic Era pre-raid best-in-slot lists for the
simulated specs. Every item listed here joins src/data/items/pre-bis.json whatever its quality or level
(it must still be equippable and pass the Season of Discovery id guard), and pool items get
preRaidBis: [{ spec, slot, rank }]. Curated 2026-09-22 (user request: 'If there are some pre-raid BIS
that aren't in our filter they should be included too'); mage lists added 2026-09-24.
See docs/data/items.md#pre-raid-bis-lists.
Sources (doctrine section 2, Classic Era only): Wowhead's WoW Classic pre-raid BiS guides as archived
in May 2021, before Season of Mastery and before TBC Classic. The same guides on wowhead.com today have
been rewritten for Season of Mastery ('...Pre-Raid Best in Slot Gear list for Protection Warrior Tank in
WoW Classic Season of Mastery'), which the doctrine forbids, so the archived versions are cited.
Wowhead's Classic mage guide has no Fire list, so mage-fire cites Icy Veins' Classic guide, archived
in February 2021 (also before Season of Mastery).
Selection: the guide's order is the rank (1 = BiS, 2+ = alternatives). Each slot keeps the top pick plus
two alternatives; finger and trinket keep four, since two are worn. The guides link Horde PvP items;
the Alliance counterpart is added at the same rank. PvP items are Rank 10 or lower. No raid drops.
An item Forever redesigned out of the spec's role is left out and keeps no rank; the other entries keep
the guide's rank, and the spec's note says why (Diamond Flask, docs/classes/warrior.md Q30).
Random-suffix items are listed by their base id, and the pool has only the base row's stats (no
suffix). One whose base row has no spell stats is left out like a raid drop: the entries below it
move up, and the spec's note names it. One that keeps a rank has the guide's suffix in its notes.
These are Classic Era lists. Forever re-itemized many of these items and added level-55+ dungeons with
no recorded drops yet, so Forever's real pre-raid BiS will differ. The only Forever BiS lists found on
2026-09-22 were for level 20; replace these lists when a level-60 Forever one exists.

selection.excludes: raid drops (MC, Onyxia, ZG, AQ20, BWL and later), Season of Discovery/Mastery, TBC+

mage-fire.name: Fire Mage

source.title: Mage DPS Pre-Raid Gear - WoW Classic - Icy Veins

mage-fire.note: Wowhead's Classic guide has no Fire list, so this is Icy Veins' Classic mage pre-raid list, which says it is for Fire mages heading into AQ40 (Phase 5; last updated 2020-12-06); its low-ranked Frost-only swaps fall outside the kept ranks. Its Horde PvP and Arathi Basin gear gets the Alliance counterpart at the same rank. Its Bloodvine set and Flarecore Leggings are crafted, not raid drops, but need Zul'Gurub / Molten Core materials. Its random-suffix items whose base item has no spell stats are left out, so the entries below them move up: Archivist Cape (back); Flameweave Cuffs, Tearfall Bracers, Master's Bracers and Abyssal Cloth Wristbands (wrist); Demon Blade (main hand). Abyssal Cloth Amice and Drakestone are random-suffix too but keep their rank on their base stats, without the guide's suffix. The guide's Diana's Pearl Necklace is 22403, named Nacreous Shell Necklace in the client, and it links Dryad's Wrist Bindings 19597 (the level-49 bracket version), so the level-60 version 19595 is listed instead.

mage-frost.name: Frost Mage

source.title: Classic Mage Best in Slot (BiS) Pre-Raid Gear Guide - WoW Classic 1.13

mage-frost.note: Wowhead's guide (Phase 6 heading, patch 1.13.7, last updated 2020-12-07) gives one mage list with no spec split; it is a Frost list: every random-suffix pick is 'of Frozen Wrath' and it ranks Frost-only items high (Boreal Mantle, Freezing Lich Robes, Tome of the Ice Lord, Wand of Biting Cold, Freezing Band). Its Horde PvP cloth gets the Alliance counterpart at the same rank. Its random-suffix items whose base item has no spell stats are left out, so the entries below them move up: Solstice Staff (its rank-1 staff), Eternal Spaulders, Archivist Cape and Master's Cloak, Tearfall Bracers (with Flameweave Cuffs and Master's Bracers below it), Master's Boots, Bloodstrike Dagger and Lunar Wand. So the back, main-hand and two-hand rows keep only the guide's two other items. Drakestone is random-suffix too but keeps its rank on its base +7 spell power, without the guide's suffix.
